NGD Media launch video assets (place optimized MP4s here):

launch-hero-desktop.mp4  — 1920x1080 / 16:9; H.264 MP4, no audio track, 12-20 s seamless loop; aim for 2-5 MB.
launch-hero-mobile.mp4   — 720x1280 / 9:16; H.264 MP4, no audio track, 12-20 s loop; aim for 1-2 MB.
launch-sizzle.mp4        — 16:9 produced showreel with sound, click-to-play (NOT autoloaded).

Desktop / mobile hero sources switch at <=767px OR portrait orientation. Video only loads one active source at a time. Provide the launch-poster.webp fallback in assets/images. Motion preferences are respected.
